headline: Europe Funds Ukraine While Irish Refinery Supplies Russia
facebook_description: Ireland exported 775,985 metric tons of alumina to Russia in 2025. Investigators traced Russian smelters receiving Irish material to a distributor supplying defense contractors. The refinery denies military use, and an Irish government review could neither establish nor exclude it. The shipments remain legal under EU sanctions. Should Europe restrict these exports? Follow EP News for independent investigations. #Ireland #Russia #Ukraine #EUNews
